overview: Store an optional expires_at per link and enforce it in LinkService.resolve after the cache lookup. ResolvedLink carries expiresAt so cached entries stay correct without extra queries. Creation accepts expiresInSeconds (1 second to 10 years), converted to an absolute instant with the injected Clock. Expired links raise LinkExpiredException, mapped to 410 Gone with urn:problem:link-expired, which tells clients the link existed but is no longer valid (unlike 404). The schema change is a new, nullable column, so the change is backward compatible and safe to deploy before or after the code.

components.name: LinkService
components.responsibility: TTL on create; expiry enforcement for every resolve

apiChanges.description: New expiresAt field (null when the link never expires)
410 Gone with urn:problem:link-expired for expired links

schemaChanges: V2__add_link_expiry.sql: ALTER TABLE link ADD COLUMN expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE (nullable)

decisions.decision: Relative TTL (expiresInSeconds) in the API, absolute instant in storage
decisions.rationale: Clients do not need synchronized clocks; storage stays unambiguous

decisions.decision: 410 Gone instead of 404 for expired links
decisions.rationale: Distinguishes expired from never-existed for clients and support

decisions.decision: Check expiry after the cache lookup
decisions.rationale: Cache entries outlive expiry; enforcing on every resolve keeps hits correct at zero query cost
NULL means never expires, which is exactly the required behaviour for existing links

alternatives.whyNotChosen: Loses analytics and turns 410 into 404; can be added later as a purge job

alternatives.option: Evict expired entries via cache TTL
alternatives.whyNotChosen: Cache TTL is global; per-link expiry would still need a check on hits

risks.description: Expired links that are cached keep redirecting
risks.mitigation: Enforce expiry on every resolve including cache hits; integration test with a warmed cache and a controllable clock
Additive nullable column only; verified by the migration safety stage

testStrategy: Unit-test Link.isExpiredAt boundaries. Integration-test with a @Primary mutable Clock: expiresAt in metadata, 302 before expiry, 410 after expiry with a warmed cache, no-expiry links after ten years, and validation of expiresInSeconds bounds. Run the full existing suite to prove backward compatibility.
rollbackPlan: Revert the application commit; the nullable expires_at column is ignored by the previous release, so no down-migration is needed. If required, drop the column in a later release after all instances run code that does not map it.
